page.title: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review instructions. Link a skill to agents: when it is enabled, its text is appended to their prompt in the order you set.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill from scratch or import a SKILL.md file or package.

card.usedBy: {count, plural, =0 {not linked} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: Kebab-case, unique in the workspace. The model sees it as the skill heading.
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag every branch the diff adds that no test exercises.
fields.descriptionHint: The skill's interface: write it as a directive — what the reviewer must flag, and when. It is sent to the model right under the skill name.
fields.bodyHint: The checklist the model follows. Text only: a skill cannot run tools or scripts.
fields.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule

- What to check
- How to report it

drawer.subtitle: {type} · {source} · v{version}
drawer.notUsed: Not linked to any agent yet.
drawer.disabledNote: Disabled: no agent receives this skill.

config.title: Configuration
config.nextVersion: Saving snapshots the body as v{version}.
config.sameVersion: Type and enabled are metadata: the skill stays at v{version}.
config.notePlaceholder: e.g. Flag empty arrays as a boundary case
config.noteHint: Optional. Titles v{version} in the version history; the model never sees it.
config.deleteBody: Removes it from every agent that links it. This can't be undone.
config.deleteUsedBy: {count, plural, one {Linked to # agent} other {Linked to # agents}}: {names}.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it, under “## Skills / rules” in the user message.

stats.title: Usage
stats.subtitle: Last 30 days of review runs in this workspace.
stats.pullSub: {skillRuns} of {runs, plural, one {# review run} other {# review runs}}
stats.findingsSub: in the runs that loaded it
stats.agentsEmpty: Not linked to any agent yet.
stats.emptyTitle: No review run loaded this skill yet
stats.emptyBody: In the last 30 days no run had it in its prompt. Link it to an agent, keep it enabled and run a review: the numbers appear here.
stats.footnote: Findings belong to the whole review run that loaded the skill: a run with several skills counts its findings for each of them.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every change to what the model sees snapshots the body, so each run can be traced to the exact text it used.
versions.diffSame: The body is the same as in v{version}: this version changed the name or description.
versions.diffSkipped: {count, plural, one {# unchanged line} other {# unchanged lines}}

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is text the reviewing agent follows. Nothing in it is executed.

import.subtitle: Nothing is saved until you review the preview and confirm.
import.fileHint: A SKILL.md or other .md file, or a .zip / .skill package, up to 1 MiB. Only the skill core is read; scripts and other files are listed, never run.
import.urlHint: https only. GitHub file pages are read raw. Private and local addresses are refused.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MiB.
import.trustTitle: You are importing someone else's instructions
import.trustBody: Once linked to an agent, this text goes into its prompt as review rules. Read all of it before saving, the way you would review a dependency.

community.title: Search community skills
community.subtitle: Import skills from public repos: every import is previewed and saved only after you confirm.
community.hint: Type at least 2 characters or pick a tag to search public GitHub repos for SKILL.md files.
community.notConfigured: Community search needs a GitHub token. Add one in <link>Settings → API keys</link>.
